title: Strike
wikitext:
'''Strike''' skills are [[melee skill]]s which hit a single target or all enemies with a melee's swing radius. They are not the same as [[slam]] melee skills.

Strike skills are supportable by either {{il|Ancestral Call Support}}, to process multiple secondary effects from the skill, or {{il|Melee Splash Support}} to create overlapping novas on each enemy hit by the original swing.

==Gems==
===Skill gems===
There are {{Drop enabled gem count|where=items.class_id="Active Skill Gem" AND skill_gems.gem_tags HOLDS "Strike"}} [[active skill gem]]s with the [[:Category:Strike (gem tag)|Strike]] [[gem tag]]:
{{Drop enabled gem table
|where=items.class_id="Active Skill Gem"
   AND skill_gems.gem_tags HOLDS "Strike"
|dmgeff=dmgeff
|aspd=aspd
}}

===Support gems===
There are {{Drop enabled gem count|where=items.class_id="Support Skill Gem" AND skill_gems.gem_tags HOLDS "Strike"}} [[support skill gem]]s with the [[:Category:Strike (gem tag)|Strike]] [[gem tag]]:
{{Drop enabled gem table
|where=items.class_id="Support Skill Gem"
   AND skill_gems.gem_tags HOLDS "Strike"
}}

==Related unique items==
The following [[unique item]]s are related to Strike skills:
{{Drop enabled unique item table
|where=items.stat_text LIKE "%Strike%skill%" 
AND items.stat_text NOT LIKE "%critical%strike%" 
AND items.stat_text NOT LIKE "%molten%strike%"
AND items.stat_text NOT LIKE "%culling%strike%"
AND items.stat_text NOT LIKE "%Melee%Strike%Range%"
|large=1
|base_item=1
|level=1
|stat=1
}}

The following [[unique item]]s are related to Melee Strike ranges :

Melee Strike Range {{c|help|affects Melee Strikes, including the Default Attack. Does not apply to Areas of Effect}} (unless otherwise state, such as {{il|Cyclone}}).
{{Item table
|where=items.stat_text LIKE "%Melee%Strike%Range%" AND items.rarity_id = "unique" AND items.is_in_game = true
|large=1
|base_item=1
|level=1
|stat=1
|drop_enabled=1
}}

==Passive Skills==
These [[passive skill]]s are related to Strike skills:

===Base passives===
{{Query base passive skills
|where=
  passive_skill_stats.id LIKE "%melee_range%" OR passive_skill_stats.id LIKE "%melee_splash%" 
  OR passive_skill_stats.id LIKE "%extra_target%" 
}}

===Masteries===
The following [[Passive Mastery|Masteries]] are related to Strike skills:
{{Query masteries|where=mastery_effects.stat_text_raw LIKE "%strike%" 
  AND mastery_effects.stat_text_raw NOT LIKE "%critical%strike%" AND mastery_effects.stat_text_raw NOT LIKE "%culling%strike%"}}

===Cluster Jewel passive skills===
The following [[Cluster Jewel]] passives are related to Strike skills:
{{Passive skill table
|q_where=
  passive_skills.id LIKE "affliction%"
  AND passive_skills.stat_text LIKE "%melee%strike%range%"
|large=1
|stat_text=1
}}

===Ascendancy passive skills===
There are [[Ascendancy passive skill]]s related to Strike skills:
{{Query ascendancy passive skills
|where=passive_skill_stats.id LIKE "%melee_range%" 
}}

==Related modifiers==
The following modifiers are related to Strike skills: 
{{Query spawnable modifiers
|where=mods.domain = 1 AND mods.generation_type NOT IN (10, 31) 

AND (mod_stats.id LIKE "%strike%"
AND mod_stats.id NOT LIKE "%critical%strike%"
AND mod_stats.id NOT LIKE "%culling_strike%"
AND mod_stats.id NOT LIKE "%multistrike%"
AND mod_stats.id NOT LIKE "%level_x_spirit_strike%")
OR mod_stats.id LIKE "%melee%range%"
|stat_text=1
|spawn_weights=1
|level=1
|generation_type =1
}}
===Melee Strike Range===
{{Query spawnable modifiers
|where= mods.generation_type NOT LIKE 10 AND mod_stats.id LIKE "%melee%range%" AND ( mods.domain = 1 OR mods.domain = 9)
|stat_text=1
|spawn_weights=1
|level=1
|generation_type =1
|domain=1
}}

==Version history==
{{Version history table header}}
{{Version history table row|3.25.0|
* Skills that use the basic melee strike animation now have a more consistent swing speed, rather than the first swing being slower than the second swing.
}}
{{Version history table row|3.21.0|
* Vaal Strike Skills can no longer be supported by Ancestral Call, and are no longer affected by stats that cause strike skills to target additional enemies.
}}
{{Version history table row|3.10.0|
* Modifiers to Melee Weapon and Unarmed Attack Range are now described as "{{c|mod|+X to Melee Strike Range}}". The functionality hasn't changed. Weapons that describe their range still refer to "Weapon Range".
}}
{{Version history table row|3.7.0|
* Introduced to the game as gem tag.
}}
{{Version history table end}}
